title: Tril Does not Support SymInt
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

If torch.export a module containing tril with dynamic shape, there will be tril related symbol failure

PS: Triu most likely has the same issue as well

### Versions

2.9, 2.8, 2.7.1
